## Design

### 2026-10-09 – I have never designed my own PCB and was completely aware of that upcoming time limit, but I stayed ambitious and decided to build something that I had always wanted. A MacroPad! At first, I thought t

**5h**

I have never designed my own PCB and was completely aware of that upcoming time limit, but I stayed ambitious and decided to build something that I had always wanted. A MacroPad! At first, I thought the MacroPad was going to be relatively beginner friendly until I actually began designing my PCB. I had no clue on where to start my own, so I began by watching multiple tutorials how to actually use KiCad (not included in the time) and researching on what I wanted to build. When I came to begin drawing diagrams, I was COOKED - like deep fried. I think I spent 1.5 hrs on this :  ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/ca6cb3eda24aacbd42f9c38aa7339ff497afcac50c30fe737bfad98adc573d3d.png)

I then attempted to move on to different parts and different diagrams. I wanted to make it really cool like with knobs and LED lights, but then I realised the extreme difficulty of my ideal project and decided to scrap it completely due to skills and time constraints.

Therefore, I ended up designing the bare minimum for this project to work, LED display, keycaps and a battery - and of course a micro-controller.

I had bits where I had no clue what I was doing like this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/a6ddb931eec4bd2aa69c73c94753de9527d6bdf5d0c1fca436a2797c087e4fed.png)

AND this,
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/7dcdc38b8f4cb006f8a2a163b7fe4f3597acf81847ead2263f8911fcfb0a20d2.png)

But ended up completing this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/b620242e29d262e5eefb6d8d9b752b0a675ec4d7c7e760904e27886f10b202c0.png)
and

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/3057a5dbee03bd601fe3a35cf7872c9f04730cf933faf7b1322d1a2207958132.png)

I plan to complete all of the  PCB diagrams tomorrow.

### 2026-10-10 – OMG brooo. I am done for. It is so hard. My dad used to do these stuff before he switched careers and he kinda remembers, so we spent so long together trying to edit the PCB layout and tracing stuff.

**3.5h**

OMG brooo. I am done for. It is so hard. My dad used to do these stuff before he switched careers and he kinda remembers, so we spent so long together trying to edit the PCB layout and tracing stuff. He barely did anything though - that old man barely remembers what PCB is - at least he tried :D. I finished the schematic somehow - I actually don't know how (probablly a lot of errors).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/23f9539d4ba7bc9c849ea93fcbe32c15194a34fd35f0d89da9b82cf3d863ea9f.png)

I then moved on to creating the PCB layout which is a complete new skill set that I have no clue on how to do. I managed to layout everything, but then I got stuck on the tracing part, hopefully I can finish that tomorrow as the deadlines up soon.
